front: How did war change Nazi policy towards the Jews?
back: It brought millions more Jews under German control, made emigration impossible and led from ghettos to mass shooting to extermination camps.

front: Why was armed Jewish resistance limited?
back: Victims were starved, deceived, isolated, poorly armed and subject to collective reprisals; there were also other forms of resistance.

front: Which other groups did the Nazis persecute and kill?
back: Roma and Sinti, disabled people (T4), Soviet prisoners of war, Poles, Jehovah's Witnesses, homosexual men and political opponents.
